attempts.summary: Configured node1 (SONiC) eth0 as the real data-plane NIC on the shared 10.100.151.0/24 segment, then blocked direct IP traffic between node2 and node3 using symmetric iptables INPUT/OUTPUT DROP rules on each host (targeting the peer's IP) while leaving node1 reachable from both. Rules were made boot-persistent via /etc/rc.local (rc-local.service). All three nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory evidence protocol, with changed boot_id confirmed and isolation plus node1 reachability re-verified after each restart.
